title: Evaluating Fairness of Voting Systems: Simulating Violations of Arrow's Conditions
reasoning: The paper directly evaluates voting systems based on "fairness criteria" derived from Arrow's social choice theory. These criteria (e.g., Non-Dictatorship, Transitivity, Unanimity, Independence of Irrelevant Alternatives) are fundamental ethical and moral considerations for collective decision-making and ensuring equitable outcomes in society.
